title: Koch (2026). Reminisce: A Cognitive Science-Inspired Memory Architecture for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Tabla 2-3 (Sec 4.2-4.3), IC en Tabla 3; el propio autor advierte (Sec 7) que el benchmark solo ejercita retrieval episodico, no valida que los tres niveles mejoren desempeno vs RAG plano (RECONSIDERAR: honestidad metodologica alta pero evidencia causal de la arquitectura aun no demostrada).

title: Zhang, B. (2026). Beyond RAG: LLM Wikis as Living Semantic Memory: Patterns, Empirical Findings, and Open Problems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR (partial): most numeric results are the author's OWN first-person-reported sub-studies, several 'submitted for review, others still in revision' (sec1.6) rather than independently published/verified work -- treat magnitudes (2.5x, 2.3-7.6x, ECE, AUC) as self-reported pending peer review; sec2.4/4 (RAG-vs-wiki), sec5.4 (DCU amplification), and sec8.5 (WikiHealth blind spot) are the key evidence sections.

title: Liu et al. (2026). SafeHarbor: Defining Precise Decision Boundaries via Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Guardrail for LLM Agent Safety.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Abstract y Tabla 1 (Sec 5.1); paper de ICML 2026 con codigo publico, foco en seguridad de agentes mas que en memoria general (RECONSIDERAR: verificar si aplica al alcance de memoria SMS-v2 o es mas bien seguridad/guardrails).

title: Iscan (2026). PYTHALAB-MERA: Validation-Grounded Memory, Retrieval, and Acceptance Control for Frozen-LLM Coding Agents.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Abstract y Tabla 1 (Sec 3.1); n=9 extremadamente pequeno, un unico autor (mismo PythaLab/Yildiz que W7160456681 en este lote) con auto-caveat explicito de que no establece claims generales (RECONSIDERAR: patron recurrente de autor unico con evidencia n minima, verificar independencia/rigor editorial antes de ponderar sus claims).

title: Sultan et al. (2026). NeuSymMS: A Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Memory System for LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: Paper de arquitectura sin validacion cuantitativa propia (Sec VI cita solo trabajos externos); aplicabilidad conceptual fuerte pero evidencia empirica debil, RECONSIDERAR si se exige evidencia cuantitativa minima.

title: Liu et al. (2026). MemRepair: Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Repository-Level Vulnerability Repair.
senal_calidad: Table 2 (p.6, SEC-Bench/Multi-SWE-bench comparison) + §3.3.3 memory-scale figures (p.4) are the load-bearing evidence; clearly on-topic hierarchical + negative-knowledge memory paper, not RECONSIDERAR.

title: Chukkapalli, D., Avula, T., Aggarwal, A., Singh, H., & Tallanki, A. (2026). CommitDistill: A Lightweight Knowledge-Centric Memory Layer for Software Repositories.
senal_calidad: Ancla: Table II (section VI-A) yield numbers; RQ5 four-arm result in section VI-G2 (n=200, two judges). Clearly on-topic; no RECONSIDERAR needed.

title: Kim, T., Francois-Lavet, V. y Cochez, M. (2026). Short-Term-to-Long-Term Memory Transfer for Knowledge Graphs under Partial Observability.
senal_calidad: Ancla de evidencia: Tabla 1 (resultados train/test por variante), Sec.5.2 (analisis de keep/drop 560 decisiones, Fig.2). Estudio de mecanismo enfocado (n=5 seeds, un solo benchmark RoomKG) -- RECONSIDERAR (validez externa limitada, los propios autores lo describen como mechanism-validation study, no un barrido amplio de benchmarks).

title: Mehraj, Kafeel, and Musa (2026). M.A.K.S: Multidimensional Access Knowledge Scoring for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Memory Management.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Abstract y Sec 5.2/6; publicado en IRE Journals (venue de bajo perfil/revision no claramente rigurosa), validacion principal es un UNICO caso 'needle' n=1 contra un solo baseline FIFO, no un benchmark estandar multi-pregunta (RECONSIDERAR: rigor experimental limitado, verificar si aporta mas que la formula matematica en si).

title: He et al. (2026). What Training Data Teaches RL Memory Agents: An Empirical Study of Curriculum Effects in Memory-Augmented QA.
senal_calidad: Tabla 2 (Sec.4.1) F1 agregados; Tablas 3-4 (Sec.4.2) desglose por tipo de pregunta; Tabla 5 (Sec.5.1) filtrado de banco de memoria; Sec.5.2 colapso de reward binario en GRPO G=4. Sin RECONSIDERAR.

title: Omelchenko, I. y Strukov, V. (2025). Reflective memory architecture for adaptive planning in hierarchical LLM agents in virtual environments.
senal_calidad: Table 1 (9-config comparison) and §3.3 (CRUD operator equations) anchor the numbers; single small environment (Minigrid) and niche student-thesis venue (Karazin Kharkiv bulletin) -- RECONSIDERAR generalizability of the ablation.

title: Li, X., Zang, Y., Cao, Y., & Sun, A. (2026). Skill-as-Pseudocode: Refactoring Skill Libraries to Pseudocode for LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: Ancla: Table 1 (main ALFWorld result, n=402) + Table 3 ablation (20-game pilot) + section 5.5-adjacent retrieval-pool ablation (children as standalone drop reward 27%). Clearly on-topic; no RECONSIDERAR needed.

title: Feng et al. (2026). ExpGraph: Model-Agnostic Experience Learning with Graph-Structured Memory for LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: Table 2/3 (pp.6-7) hold the load-bearing numbers; Table 1 (p.2) contrasts the capability matrix vs prior memory methods. Not RECONSIDERAR.

title: Joshi (2026). Eywa: Provenance-Grounded Long-Term Memory for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: Sec 1 (headline numbers), Sec 4.1 (write-path audit), Table 1-2 (failure taxonomy and object model) (arXiv:2605.30771v1). RECONSIDERAR - solo-author/company research note, self-reported evaluation with published per-question artifacts but no independent third-party replication found.

title: Kwon and Bang (2026). What Spatial Memory Must Store: Occlusion as the Test for Language-Agent Memory.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: domain is embodied 3D spatial/occlusion memory in a voxel game world (Space Zero), quite orthogonal to Meta-Factory's software-factory memory use case; digested per protocol because plan_estado=SI and the ranker-vs-index/measured-negative-result methodology (§3, §6.8, p.5-6) does transfer, but direct applicability is genuinely doubtful.

title: Yang (2026). Anchor-Aware Memory Systems for AI Agents: Discovering and Preserving Latent Behavioral Signatures in Large Language Models.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: paper de un solo autor, sin peer review aparente (agradece a DeepSeek por el apoyo en todo el trabajo), tamanos de muestra pequenos (n=4 modelos, 50 rondas) y terminologia informal ('soul signature', 'Dew-Drinking Crowd'); numeros en Tabla 7-8 y Sec 7.3.

title: Singh (2026). Nous: A Predictive World Model for Long-Term Agent Memory.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: preprint de autor unico (estudiante, IIT Ropar) que el propio texto reconoce carece de ablaciones controladas ('we do not include controlled ablations', Sec 7), no verifica conteos de categoria consistentes con BeliefMem, y solo evalua evidencia BENCHMARK-E2E (sin ablacion); numeros en Tabla 1-4 y Sec 5-6.

title: Jiang et al. (2026). ManimAgent: Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents for Visual Education.
senal_calidad: Table 1 (p.8, headline + ablation blocks) is the load-bearing evidence; the explicit evaluator-leakage discussion (§3, p.6) is notable methodology. Not RECONSIDERAR — clearly on-topic dual-channel negative/positive memory paper.

title: Halaharvi (2026). HyphaeDB: A Living Knowledge Topology for Agent-First Memory.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: this is a design/vision paper from a company (HyphaeDB) with zero measured results (evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA only); the competitive capability table (S8, '9 of 13 capabilities unique') is self-reported and marketing-styled, not benchmarked. Worth a human look at whether it belongs alongside empirically-evaluated papers in this corpus.

title: Talebirad et al. (2026). From Signals to Structure: How Memory Architecture Drives Language Emergence in LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: Table 2/3 (p.3-4, Study 1) and Table 4/5 + Fig.4 (Study 2, p.5) are the load-bearing numbers; domain is emergent-communication research (Lewis signaling games), not software agents, but the core finding (memory architecture > channel capacity; un-pruned memory degrades) is a direct, generalizable memory-architecture result. Not RECONSIDERAR.
